name: Sheep
body:
SHEEP
CR 1/2

XP 200
N Medium animal
Init +2; Senses low-light vision; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 12, flat-footed 11 (+2 Dex, +1 natural)
hp 11 (2d8+2)
Fort +4, Ref +5, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +1 (1d6)

Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 15, Con 13, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 9
Base Atk +1; CMB +1; CMD 12 (16 vs. trip)
Feats Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Perception +10

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate mountains

Organization solitary, pair, or herd (3-30)

Treasure none

ABOUT

This wooly creature grazes contentedly and raises meek eyes every now and then. Sheep are kept for their milk, wool, and meat. Females (ewes) and young (lambs) are not as adept for combat as the males (rams). Sheep can vary very much in size depending on the breed. These are the stats for a common ewe.
